name: Shenzhen Urban Transport Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Urban Transport Technology Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides urban transportation solutions in China. The company offers multi-mode AI regulation business engine, evolutionary computing platform, and digital twin foundation. It also provides planning, policy research and plan consultation, engineering design, and intelligentization services for rail transit networks; data analysis, digital twin, intelligent management and control, and professional integration for transportation corridors; style traffic signal governance, systematic traffic safety governance, traffic congestion service, and intelligent parking solutions; and urban traffic dispatching AI cloud …
